description: Ministry of Mahaweli Development & Environment - Amend the Order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1466/26 declaring the Muthurajawela Environmental Protection  Area
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of an environmental protection area declaration under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it modifies existing regulations, specifies statutory instruments (Section 24 C and 24 D), and includes detailed legal descriptions of land boundaries. While it mentions the President by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio assignment, making it a legal/regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
